summary: Iteration 3: tested per-company payment data, admins limited to specific companies, and full-access team users with Master protection. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass (tests/test_iter3_companies_scope.py). All scope checks also passed a second time on data created through the UI (tests/qa_verify_ui_data_iter3.py, 10/10). UI as qa-admin: in Impostazioni, created QA Azienda Uno (IBAN, intestatario, 500, IVA 22) and QA Azienda Due (no IBAN), edited one, and set 'Pagamento predefinito'. Deleting a company with an affiliate assigned shows the 400 toast. Registered qa-aff1 through the UI (verification auto-skipped). Assigned it to Uno in scheda > Dati interni. The Affiliati list shows the company column, and the filter works for Tutte / Uno / Due / Senza azienda. Created QA Scoped (Solo aziende selezionate = Uno, 5 permissions) and QA Full (team-full; the scope and permission controls are hidden when it is checked) in the Team UI. The Master row has the 'Master' badge and no Modifica button. Affiliate payment box: qa-aff1 sees QA Uno srl / IT60X... / 610,00 EUR; qa-aff2 sees QA Default / IT02L... / 1207,80 EUR. A company without IBAN falls back to the default. /api/aff/me has no aziendaId or registrar. Scoped user (UI and API): the menu shows only Panoramica, Affiliati, Ticket, Report, Registro email and Impostazioni. Impostazioni has only the 'Password affiliati' and 'Generali' tabs (no Team, no Aziende). Only qa-aff1 appears in the affiliates list, tickets, dashboard, counts, report (affiliati=1), CSV, emails and notifications. qa-aff2's scheda and ticket return 404. PUT /settings, POST /legal, GET /team and POST /companies return 403. qa-full sees all affiliates and the Team tab; PUT /team/{master} returns 403 and the Master is unchanged. The team-creation emails do not contain the password. Auth checks: bcrypt $2b$, httpOnly cookies set, CORS rejects an unknown origin. The admin dashboard loads. Cleanup done: both QA affiliates deleted (one through the UI with ELIMINA), both QA companies deleted, default payment bank fields restored to empty, QA affiliate email logs removed. Team users qa-scoped and qa-full are left for the main agent to remove. The real affiliate Tribù and the Master were not touched.

minor.issue: MEDIUM: if a company has an IBAN, its whole pag object replaces the default, field by field with no fallback. A new company created with only IBAN, intestatario, importo and IVA (the requested test case) gives the affiliate an empty Causale (with a Copia button that copies nothing) and no 'Termine'. Its rinnovo is '' too, so /renew creates renewal payments of 0,00. The importo would be 0 if left blank. Verified: qa-aff1 got {'rinnovo': '', 'causale': '', 'scadenza': ''}. Fix: merge, e.g. {**s['pag'], **{k: v for k, v in c['pag'].items() if v}}, or pre-fill CompanyForm with the default values.

Scope is based on the recipient email, not the affiliate id. Email logs are not deleted when an affiliate is deleted, so if someone re-registers with the same address, a scoped admin sees the old logs. Reproduced: the scoped user saw a [Ticket #T-0001] email from a deleted qa-aff1. Fix: delete the email_log rows (by ref/to) in delete_aff, or scope by ref.
Admin notifications whose ref is one of the deleted affiliate's ticket ids are not removed, which leaves orphan notifications.
Returns the registrar names of all affiliates, not only the scoped admin's. Low-severity leak.
The tot, iscritti and completati counts cover all affiliates, not only the scoped ones. Low priority.
A scoped admin can mark any 'admin' notification as read by its id, including ones outside their scope. Low priority.
Leftover from iteration 1: 'years' is now built from pagatoAt or at, so this looks fixed.

design_issues.screen: Affiliati list with the company filter
issues: When the filter matches nothing (e.g. 'QA Azienda Due' with 0 affiliates), the table shows only its header and no empty-state message.

All payment fields start empty (importo, rinnovo, causale, termine). It is easy to save a company that shows an empty causale to affiliates. Pre-fill them with the default values or show 'uses default' placeholders.

action_items: Make pag_for merge company pag with the default for empty fields (causale, scadenza, rinnovo, importo, iva), or pre-fill CompanyForm with the defaults
Optional: delete email_log rows and ticket-ref notifications when an affiliate is deleted (stops scoped admins seeing old emails after an address is reused)
Optional: scope /admin/internal-options registrars for scoped admins
Optional: show an empty state in the Affiliati table when the filter matches nothing
critical_code_review_comments: Checked in code, all correct: get_aff(aid, u) scope check returns 404; scope_all, aff_q and scope_ids are used in dashboard, counts, report, exports, emails, course purchases, tickets (tk_access and list, including the affId param) and nquery; internal() checks that the company exists and that the admin is allowed to assign it; team_fields filters perms and companies to valid values; Master protected in team_upd; the team email does not contain the password; view_aff removes aziendaId and registrar.

Any is_super user (not only the Master) can create more full-access users and edit or deactivate other full users, such as qa-admin. This matches the request ('Master can add other users with full access') but is not limited to the Master. Confirm that this is intended.
routes_admin.py is 859 lines (>700): split it (companies/team/settings into routes_settings.py).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 1 medium data/UX issue (company pag has no per-field fallback)

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted: qa-aff1 and qa-aff2 (twice: API run, then UI run), QA Azienda Uno and QA Azienda Due (twice), QA tickets (deleted with the affiliates), and their email logs. Default pag was set to QA Default / IT02L... and then restored (intestatario, iban, banca and note empty; other fields kept as before). The qa-aff1/2 affiliate state was set directly in the DB (accettata + URL) to reach the payment step; both were then deleted. The qa-scoped and qa-full team users still exist (aziende now [] because the companies were deleted) and the main agent should remove them along with qa-admin. Their team-creation emails are still in email_log.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter3_companies_scope.py runs in order and shares module state S. It needs qa-admin@test.local / QaAdmin-2026 and must not find existing qa-aff1/2, qa-scoped or qa-full users. Run qa_cleanup_iter3.py (add the 'team' arg to also remove the qa team users) before re-running. Run with -k 'not test_99' to keep the data. The autouse fixture restores the default bank fields to empty. The real Master is flagged is_master; never log in as it or modify it.
rca of the issue: pag_for returns c['pag'] as soon as the company has an IBAN. CompanyForm starts from {} and clean_pag stores every PAG_KEY as '' when it is left empty, so the empty causale, scadenza and rinnovo replace the default values. Reproduce: create a company with only IBAN, intestatario, importo and IVA, assign an affiliate, then open the affiliate's Percorso > Pagamento: Causale is empty and Termine is missing. Fix: merge the non-empty company fields over the default settings.
